CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO substring_index(str, delim, cnt) AS
  CASE WHEN cnt >= 0
       THEN array_to_string(list_slice(string_split(str, delim), 1, cnt), delim)
       ELSE array_to_string(list_slice(string_split(str, delim),
              -cnt * -1, len(string_split(str, delim))), delim)
  END
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE rvfph_prospective_.dual AS SELECT 1 AS dummy

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE rvfph_prospective_.transitiveClosureTable AS
        WITH RECURSIVE isa(sourceid, destinationid) AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT sourceid, destinationid
              FROM rvfph_prospective_.relationship_active
             WHERE typeid = 116680003
        ),
        tc(sourceid, destinationid) AS (
            SELECT sourceid, destinationid FROM isa
            UNION
            -- Join the working table against the BASE relation, never against
            -- the CTE twice. A recursive reference resolves to the working
            -- table (the rows added by the previous iteration), not the whole
            -- accumulated result, so `tc a JOIN tc b` silently drops every path
            -- that needs an old row joined to a new one - producing a closure
            -- that looks plausible (5.3M rows) but is short by ~3M pairs.
            SELECT isa.sourceid, tc.destinationid
              FROM isa JOIN tc ON isa.destinationid = tc.sourceid
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT sourceid, destinationid FROM tc

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isDescendentOf_cr(candidate, target) AS
  (SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT sourceid AS _src, destinationid AS _dst
                           FROM rvfph_prospective_.transitiveClosureTable) _t
    WHERE _t._src = candidate AND _t._dst = target)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isAncestorOf_cr(candidate, target) AS
  (SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT sourceid AS _src, destinationid AS _dst
                           FROM rvfph_prospective_.transitiveClosureTable) _t
    WHERE _t._dst = candidate AND _t._src = target)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isChildOf_cr(candidate, target) AS
  (SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT sourceid AS _src, destinationid AS _dst,
                                typeid AS _typ FROM rvfph_prospective_.relationship_active) _t
    WHERE _t._src = candidate AND _t._dst = target AND _t._typ = 116680003)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isConcept_cr(candidate, target) AS
  CASE WHEN candidate = target THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isKindOf_cr(candidate, target) AS
  isDescendentOf_cr(candidate, target) + isConcept_cr(candidate, target)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isValidModuleId(candidate) AS
  isDescendentOf_cr(candidate, 900000000000443000)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isValidRefsetId_cr(candidate) AS
  isDescendentOf_cr(candidate, 900000000000455006)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isActiveConcept_cr(candidate) AS
  (SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT id AS _cid FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_active) _c
    WHERE _c._cid = candidate)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isActiveMemberOf_cr_refset(candidate, targetRefset) AS
  (SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT refsetid AS _rsid,
                                referencedcomponentid AS _rcid
                           FROM rvfph_prospective_.simplerefset_active) _m
    WHERE _m._rsid = targetRefset AND _m._rcid = candidate)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isValidComponentId_cr(candidate) AS
  CASE
    WHEN length(candidate) >= 19 THEN false
    WHEN substr(candidate, length(candidate) - 1, 1) = '0' THEN
      (SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT id AS _i FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s) _q
        WHERE _q._i = TRY_CAST(candidate AS BIGINT)) > 0
    WHEN substr(candidate, length(candidate) - 1, 1) = '1' THEN
      ((SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT id AS _i FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s) _q
         WHERE _q._i = TRY_CAST(candidate AS BIGINT))
       + (SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT id AS _i FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s) _q
           WHERE _q._i = TRY_CAST(candidate AS BIGINT))) > 0
    WHEN substr(candidate, length(candidate) - 1, 1) = '2' THEN
      (SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT id AS _i FROM rvfph_prospective_.relationship_s) _q
        WHERE _q._i = TRY_CAST(candidate AS BIGINT)) > 0
    ELSE false
  END

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO get_cr_FSN(candidate) AS
  (SELECT _d._term FROM (SELECT term AS _term, conceptid AS _cid,
                                typeid AS _typ, languagecode AS _lang
                           FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_active) _d
    WHERE _d._cid = candidate AND _d._typ = 900000000000003001
      AND _d._lang = 'en' LIMIT 1)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO get_cr_ADRS_PT(candidate) AS
  (SELECT _j._term FROM (
      SELECT da.term AS _term, da.conceptid AS _cid
        FROM rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_active AS lr
        JOIN rvfph_prospective_.description_active AS da ON da.id = lr.referencedcomponentid
       WHERE lr.refsetid = 32570271000036106
         AND da.typeid = 900000000000013009
         AND lr.acceptabilityid = 900000000000548007) _j
    WHERE _j._cid = candidate LIMIT 1)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO get_cr_PercentDefined(refset) AS
  (SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT id AS _cid, definitionstatusid AS _dsid
                           FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_active) _c
     WHERE _c._dsid = 900000000000073002
       AND _c._cid IN (SELECT _m._rcid FROM (
              SELECT referencedcomponentid AS _rcid, refsetid AS _rsid
                FROM rvfph_prospective_.simplerefset_active) _m WHERE _m._rsid = refset)) * 100.0
  / NULLIF((SELECT count(1) FROM (SELECT refsetid AS _rsid
                                    FROM rvfph_prospective_.simplerefset_active) _m
             WHERE _m._rsid = refset), 0)

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isPositiveInteger(candidate) AS
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_CAST(candidate AS DOUBLE) IS NULL THEN false
    WHEN TRY_CAST(candidate AS DOUBLE) <= 0 THEN false
    WHEN round(TRY_CAST(candidate AS DOUBLE)) <> TRY_CAST(candidate AS DOUBLE) THEN false
    ELSE true
  END

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isValidUUID(candidate) AS
  CASE
    WHEN length(candidate) <> 36 THEN false
    WHEN substr(candidate, 9, 1) <> '-' THEN false
    WHEN substr(candidate, 14, 1) <> '-' THEN false
    WHEN substr(candidate, 19, 1) <> '-' THEN false
    WHEN substr(candidate, 24, 1) <> '-' THEN false
    ELSE true
  END

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO isValidTimeFormat(candidate) AS
  CASE
    WHEN length(candidate) <> 8 THEN false
    WHEN TRY_CAST(substr(candidate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IS NULL THEN false
    WHEN TRY_CAST(substr(candidate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 2002 THEN false
    WHEN TRY_CAST(substr(candidate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 2099 THEN false
    WHEN TRY_CAST(substr(candidate, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) < 1 THEN false
    WHEN TRY_CAST(substr(candidate, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) > 12 THEN false
    WHEN TRY_CAST(substr(candidate, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) < 1 THEN false
    WHEN TRY_CAST(substr(candidate, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) > 31 THEN false
    WHEN NOT isPositiveInteger(candidate) THEN false
    ELSE true
  END

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO rvfph_prospective_.cleanExpression(str) AS
  replace(replace(replace(replace(str,'(',''),')',''),'=',','),':',',')

statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', c.id, 'Inactive concept (' || c.id || '|' || COALESCE(d1.term, 'NO ACTIVE FSN FOUND') || '|) missing active Preferred Term in one or more English dialects.', c.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_d' FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_d AS c LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS d1 ON d1.conceptid = c.id AND d1.typeid = 900000000000003001 AND d1.active = 1 WHERE c.active = 0 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS d2, rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s AS l WHERE c.id = d2.conceptid AND l.referencedcomponentid = d2.id AND l.active = 1 AND d2.active = 1 AND d2.typeid = 900000000000013009 AND l.acceptabilityid = 900000000000548007 AND l.refsetid = 900000000000508004) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS d2, rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s AS l WHERE c.id = d2.conceptid AND l.referencedcomponentid = d2.id AND l.active = 1 AND d2.active = 1 AND d2.typeid = 900000000000013009 AND l.acceptabilityid = 900000000000548007 AND l.refsetid = 900000000000509007))

22d3065c-98d3-458e-b020-35eec49b4be3.text: Newly inactive concepts must have an active historical association to an active concept - Inactivation reason requires specifying a historical association.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', c.id, 'Inactive concept (' || c.id || '|' || COALESCE(d.term, 'NO ACTIVE FSN FOUND') || '|) missing active historical association to active concept.', c.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_d' FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_d AS c LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS d ON d.conceptid = c.id AND d.active = 1 AND d.typeid = 900000000000003001 LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.attributevaluerefset_s AS i ON i.referencedcomponentid = c.id AND i.active = 1 AND i.refsetid = '900000000000489007' AND NOT i.valueid IN ('723277005', '900000000000487009', '1186919006', '900000000000483008') WHERE c.active = 0 AND NOT i.id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s AS a, rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS c2 WHERE a.referencedcomponentid = c.id AND a.active = 1 AND a.targetcomponentid = c2.id AND c2.active = 1)

30947783-78f5-4ffc-a22b-b03d83c5909d.text: The concepts referenced by expressions in LOINC ExpressionAssociationRefset SNAPSHOT file must exist in the concept snapshot.
statements:
insert into qa_result
    (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name)
select 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', try_cast(result.conceptId as bigint),
       concat('Concept: id=', result.conceptId,
              ' referenced in the ExpressionAssociationRefset SNAPSHOT is unknown.'),
       null, 'curr_expressionassociationrefset_s'
from (
    select distinct u.tok as conceptId
    from rvfph_prospective_.expressionassociationrefset_s t,
         unnest(string_split(cleanExpression(t.expression), ',')) as u(tok)
    where trim(u.tok) <> ''
) result
left join rvfph_prospective_.concept_s b on try_cast(result.conceptId as bigint) = b.id
where b.id is null

b13de2c2-d16b-4946-9e9f-3b9f24f13632.text: Every active concept has an active FSN and an active synonym.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', c.id, 'CONCEPT: id=' || c.id || ': Active concept does not have an active ' || CASE WHEN r.typeid = '900000000000003001' THEN 'FSN' ELSE 'synonym' END || '.', c.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS c INNER JOIN (SELECT '900000000000003001' AS typeid UNION ALL SELECT '900000000000013009') AS r ON NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS d WHERE d.conceptid = c.id AND d.active = '1' AND d.typeid = r.typeid) WHERE c.active = '1'

8090d441-7aeb-4a48-bdc3-2545916aa26d.text: Active concepts must have correct definition status according to defined axioms.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.id, 'Active concept ' || a.id || ' is having incorrect definition status according to defined axioms', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT referencedcomponentid FROM rvfph_prospective_.owlexpressionrefset_s WHERE active = '1' AND owlexpression LIKE '%EquivalentClasses%') AS b ON a.id = b.referencedcomponentid WHERE a.active = '1' AND a.definitionstatusid = '900000000000074008' AND NOT b.referencedcomponentid IS NULL

b72bc5f4-7afb-4a2e-ac3a-e0f4373b03e6.text: Active concepts do not have active inactivation indicators.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', b.id, 'Active concept ' || a.referencedcomponentid || ' has inactivation reason ' || a.valueid, a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.attributevaluerefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.attributevaluerefset_s AS a JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS b ON a.referencedcomponentid = b.id WHERE a.refsetid = '900000000000489007' AND a.active = 1 AND b.active = 1 AND NOT a.valueid IN ('900000000000486000', '900000000000492006', '900000000000495008')

e2aa5b09-5754-484f-9eb8-bb18732617ef.text: Active descriptions do not have active inactivation indicators.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', b.conceptid, 'Active description ' || a.referencedcomponentid || ' has inactivation reason ' || a.valueid, b.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.description_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.attributevaluerefset_s AS a JOIN rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS b ON a.referencedcomponentid = b.id WHERE a.refsetid = '900000000000490003' AND a.active = 1 AND b.active = 1 AND NOT a.valueid IN ('900000000000486000', '900000000000492006', '900000000000495008')

70befe18-cb16-4b86-bd49-e624ce5f6ae7.text: All referencedComponentIds in the OWL Expression Refset Snapshot File must refer to valid and active concepts.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'Active OWL axiom: id=' || a.id || ' is referencing an ' || CASE WHEN b.id IS NULL THEN 'invalid' ELSE 'inactive' END || ' concept.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.owlexpressionrefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.owlexpressionrefset_s AS a LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS b ON a.referencedcomponentid = b.id WHERE a.active = 1 AND (b.id IS NULL OR b.active = 0)

d2727004-cfed-4798-8710-1a088833e775.text: Association reference records are referencing the same concept for both referencedComponentId and targetComponentId.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'MEMBER: id=' || a.id || ': Association reference record is referencing the same concept ' || a.referencedcomponentid || ' for both referencedComponentId and targetComponentId.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = '1' AND a.referencedcomponentid = a.targetcomponentid

18a9f6b4-b66f-4af3-8c67-2a07b4655d27.text: IDs must be unique in the Association Refset Snapshot file.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', ANY_VALUE(a.referencedcomponentid) AS referencedcomponentid, 'ASSOC RS: id=' || a.id || ':Non unique id in current release file.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s AS a GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(a.id) > 1

638e1194-1934-11e7-819d-3c15c2c6e32e.text: There is only one active inactivation reason for a given referenced component in the attribute value snapshot.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'Reference component id:' || a.referencedcomponentid || ' has multiple inactivation reasons', ANY_VALUE(a.id) AS id, 'rvfph_prospective_.attributevaluerefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.attributevaluerefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 GROUP BY a.referencedcomponentid, a.refsetid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.valueid) > 1

e202807d-915d-4c8a-8f02-c6e4e6f969fc.text: IDs must be unique in the Attribute Value Refset Snapshot file.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', ANY_VALUE(a.referencedcomponentid) AS referencedcomponentid, 'Attribute value refset: id=' || a.id || ':Non unique id in snapshot file.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.attributevaluerefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.attributevaluerefset_s AS a GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(a.id) > 1

7e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e44b540.text: Active higher mapGroup must have at least one non empty mapTarget.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedComponentId, 'ComplexMap: id=' || a.id || ': Higher-level map group with only blank map targets', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.mapGroup > 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS b WHERE a.refSetId = b.refSetId AND a.referencedComponentId = b.referencedComponentId AND a.mapGroup = b.mapGroup AND b.mapTarget <> '')

7e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e44b560.text: Gender rules must be in alphabetical order in complex map refset.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedComponentId, 'ComplexMap: id=' || a.id || ' : Gender mapRules out of order', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS a, rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS b WHERE a.active = 1 AND b.active = 1 AND a.refSetId = b.refSetId AND a.referencedComponentId = b.referencedComponentId AND a.mapGroup = b.mapGroup AND a.mapRule = 'IFA 248153007 | Male (finding) |' AND b.mapRule = 'IFA 248152002 | Female (finding) |' AND a.mapPriority < b.mapPriority

7e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e42b580.text: Rule based complex MapGroup must be in sequential order and not blank.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedComponentId, 'ComplexMap: id=' || a.id || ': mapGroup is blank', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND (a.mapGroup IS NULL OR a.mapGroup = '') AND a.refSetId IN (SELECT DISTINCT (b.refSetId) FROM rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS b WHERE b.active = 1 AND mapRule <> '')

INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedComponentId, 'ComplexMap: id=' || a.id || ': Non-sequential map group:' || a.mapGroup, a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.mapGroup > 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS b WHERE a.refSetId = b.refSetId AND a.referencedComponentId = b.referencedComponentId AND b.mapGroup = a.mapGroup - 1)

7e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e44c610.text: Active complex map IFA rules referenced concepts and terms must be active.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedComponentId, 'ComplexMap: id=' || a.id || ': IFA rule references missing conceptId and term', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.mapRule LIKE 'IFA%' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS b, rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS c WHERE b.active = 1 AND b.id = SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.mapRule, ' ', 2), 5) AND b.id = c.conceptid AND c.term = RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(a.mapRule, STRPOS(a.mapRule, '|') + 1), '|', 1))))

6e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e43b590.text: MapPriority must be in sequential order.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedComponentId, 'ComplexMap: id=' || a.id || ': Non-sequential mapPriority:' || a.mapPriority, a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.mapPriority > 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS b WHERE a.refSetId = b.refSetId AND a.referencedComponentId = b.referencedComponentId AND a.mapGroup = b.mapGroup AND b.mapPriority = a.mapPriority - 1)

7e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e44b550.text: Active complex maps should not have the same mapTarget in different groups for a given referenced component.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedComponentId, 'ComplexMap: id=' || ANY_VALUE(a.id) || ': mapTarget=' || a.mapTarget || ' is in more than one mapGroup', ANY_VALUE(a.id) AS id, 'rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.complexmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.mapTarget <> '' GROUP BY a.referencedComponentId, a.mapTarget HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.mapGroup) > 1

530f9483-ff33-474f-85b7-29899b1d6f83.text: Active concepts have at least one active axiom in the same module as the concepts themselves.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.id, 'CONCEPT: id=' || a.id || ': Active concept has no active axiom in the same module as the concept.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS a WHERE a.active = '1' AND a.id <> 138875005 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rvfph_prospective_.owlexpressionrefset_s WHERE referencedcomponentid = a.id AND moduleid = a.moduleid AND active = '1')

309d0620-0a32-43a6-9d08-8e6bdefda3be.text: IDs must be unique in the Concept Snapshot file.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.id, 'CONCEPT: id=' || a.id || ':Non unique id in current release file.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS a GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(a.id) > 1

f55ed5ec-fc57-429c-8190-bbd5cbb8343a.text: Core module concepts have core module parents.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', child_concept.id, 'Core module concept ' || child_concept.id || ' has Model module parent ', child_concept.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS child_concept, rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS parent_concept, rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS child_desc, rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS parent_desc, rvfph_prospective_.relationship_s AS r WHERE child_concept.active = 1 AND parent_concept.active = 1 AND child_desc.active = 1 AND parent_desc.active = 1 AND child_desc.conceptid = child_concept.id AND parent_desc.conceptid = parent_concept.id AND child_desc.typeid = 900000000000003001 AND parent_desc.typeid = 900000000000003001 AND r.active = 1 AND r.sourceid = child_concept.id AND r.destinationid = parent_concept.id AND r.typeid = '116680003' AND parent_concept.moduleid = '900000000000012004' AND child_concept.moduleid = '900000000000207008'

c0869af0-7f25-11e1-b0c4-0800200c9a66.text: CTV3 simple map refset members are always active.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'MEMBER: id=' || a.id || ': CTV3 simple map refset member is not active.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.simplemaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.simplemaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.refsetid = '900000000000497000' AND a.active <> '1'

f14d521f-2472-4871-9c4e-356f0f075a3a.text: CTV3 codes are unique in the CTV3 simple map refset.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', ANY_VALUE(a.referencedcomponentid) AS referencedcomponentid, 'CTV3 Code = ' || a.maptarget || 'is not unique', ANY_VALUE(a.id) AS id, 'rvfph_prospective_.simplemaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.simplemaprefset_s AS a INNER JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS b ON a.referencedcomponentid = b.id WHERE NOT a.maptarget IS NULL AND a.refsetid = '900000000000497000' GROUP BY a.maptarget HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY a.maptarget NULLS FIRST

bab42070-7f25-11e1-b0c4-0800200c9a66.text: There is one and only one CTV3 simple map refset member per concept.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'CONCEPT: id=' || a.referencedcomponentid || ': Concept has more than one associated CTV3 refset member.', ANY_VALUE(a.id) AS id, 'rvfph_prospective_.simplemaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.simplemaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.refsetid = '900000000000497000' GROUP BY a.referencedcomponentid HAVING COUNT(a.referencedcomponentid) > 1
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS rvfph_temp_.ctv3
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rvfph_temp_.ctv3 AS SELECT referencedcomponentid FROM rvfph_prospective_.simplemaprefset_s WHERE refsetid = '900000000000497000'

INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.id, 'CONCEPT: id=' || a.id || ': Concept does not have an associated CTV3 refset member.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS a LEFT JOIN rvfph_temp_.ctv3 AS b ON a.id = b.referencedcomponentid WHERE b.referencedcomponentid IS NULL AND a.definitionstatusid <> '900000000000074008'
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS rvfph_temp_.act_ctv3

a2e01ee0-7f25-11e1-b0c4-0800200c9a66.text: CTV3 simple map refset members are unique.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'MEMBER: id=' || ANY_VALUE(a.id) || ': CTV3 member key (referencedcomponentid, maptarget) is not unique.', ANY_VALUE(a.id) AS id, 'rvfph_prospective_.simplemaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.simplemaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.refsetid = '900000000000497000' GROUP BY a.referencedcomponentid, a.maptarget HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

9733ecfe-057d-45e6-a2ca-05f3846e6d43.text: Lang refset members are active for inactive text definitions in the language refset snapshot file.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.conceptid, 'MEMBER: id=' || b.id || ': Language refset member is active for an inactive text definition.', b.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s AS a INNER JOIN rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s AS b ON a.id = b.referencedcomponentid WHERE b.active = '1' AND a.active = '0'

7c406d6c-7e30-4aa1-b99d-e00b4e2d52a5.text: There is an equivalent definition in the en-us and en-gb language when provided.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', usTestDef.conceptid, 'ConceptId=' || usTestDef.conceptid || ' has definition in EN-US but no equivalent found for EN-GB', usTestDef.conceptid, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_s' FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.conceptid FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s AS a LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s AS b ON b.referencedcomponentid = a.id WHERE b.refsetid = 900000000000509007 AND b.active = 1 AND a.active = 1) AS usTestDef LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT a.conceptid FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s AS a LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s AS b ON b.referencedcomponentid = a.id WHERE b.refsetid = 900000000000508004 AND b.active = 1 AND a.active = 1) AS gbTextDef ON usTestDef.conceptid = gbTextDef.conceptid LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS c ON usTestDef.conceptid = c.id WHERE gbTextDef.conceptid IS NULL AND c.active = 1

INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', gbTextDef.conceptid, 'ConceptId=' || gbTextDef.conceptid || ' has definition in EN-GB but no equivalent found for EN-US', gbTextDef.conceptid, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_s' FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.conceptid FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s AS a LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s AS b ON b.referencedcomponentid = a.id WHERE b.refsetid = 900000000000508004 AND b.active = 1 AND a.active = 1) AS gbTextDef LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT a.conceptid FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s AS a LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s AS b ON b.referencedcomponentid = a.id WHERE b.refsetid = 900000000000509007 AND b.active = 1 AND a.active = 1) AS usTestDef ON usTestDef.conceptid = gbTextDef.conceptid LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS c ON usTestDef.conceptid = c.id WHERE usTestDef.conceptid IS NULL AND c.active = 1

4ba823ce-8ae4-4b2e-beb5-e119b822cfe2.text: IDs must be unique in the Text Definition Snapshot file.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', ANY_VALUE(a.conceptid) AS conceptid, 'TextDefinition: id=' || a.id || ' is not unique in the TextDefinition Snapshot file.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s AS a GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(a.id) > 1

c2975dd5-3869-4bf7-ac75-53fd53b90144.text: No active term matches that of an inactive Description.
statements: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_edited_con
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_edited_con AS SELECT DISTINCT a.* FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS a JOIN rvfph_prospective_.description_d AS b ON a.id = b.conceptid AND a.active = 1
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_active_desc

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_active_desc AS SELECT a.* FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_d AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.effectivetime = (SELECT MAX(z.effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_d AS z WHERE z.id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_f AS b WHERE a.id = b.id HAVING total > 1) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM rvfph_previous_.description_s AS c WHERE a.id = c.id HAVING total > 0)
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_inactive_desc
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_inactive_desc AS SELECT a.* FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS a JOIN tmp_edited_con AS b ON a.conceptid = b.id AND a.active = 0

INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.conceptid, 'Active description id = ' || a.id || ' and inactive description id = ' || b.id || ' share the same term', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.description_d' FROM tmp_active_desc AS a JOIN tmp_inactive_desc AS b ON a.conceptid = b.conceptid AND a.moduleid = b.moduleid AND a.languagecode = b.languagecode AND a.typeid = b.typeid AND a.term = b.term WHERE a.active <> b.active AND a.effectivetime >= b.effectivetime
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_edited_con
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_active_desc
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_inactive_desc

5c0186f3-0b72-4685-8aad-eff15a7f8880.text: All active FSNs for a given concept have the same semantic tag.
statements: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_active_fsn

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_active_fsn AS SELECT a.conceptid, a.id, SUBSTRING(term, STRPOS(term, '(')) AS tag, a.term, a.languagecode FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS a WHERE a.typeid = '900000000000003001' AND a.active = 1 AND a.term LIKE '% (%)'
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_different_tag

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_different_tag AS SELECT a.conceptid FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS a, tmp_active_fsn AS b WHERE a.typeid IN ('900000000000003001') AND a.conceptid = b.conceptid AND a.languagecode = b.languagecode AND b.tag <> SUBSTRING(a.term, STRPOS(a.term, '(')) AND a.active = 1

INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.conceptid, 'DESC: conceptid=' || a.conceptid || ':Active FSN for a given concept with different semantic tag.', a.conceptid, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_s' FROM tmp_different_tag AS a
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_active_fsn
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_different_tag

19423070-7118-45bd-98ba-6d0dc18bc619.text: For each active FSN there is a synonym that has the same text.
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_consedited AS SELECT DISTINCT conceptid FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS a JOIN rvfph_prospective_.description_d AS b ON a.id = b.conceptid AND a.active = 1 AND a.moduleid = b.moduleid

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_fsn AS SELECT REPLACE(a.term, '(' || SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.term, '(', -1), '') AS termwithouttag, a.id, a.conceptid, a.term FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS a JOIN tmp_consedited AS b ON a.conceptid = b.conceptid AND a.active = 1 WHERE a.typeid = '900000000000003001' AND a.term NOT LIKE '%(product)' AND a.term NOT LIKE '%(medicinal product)' AND a.term NOT LIKE '%(medicinal product form)' AND a.term NOT LIKE '%(clinical drug)' AND a.term NOT LIKE '%(substance)' AND a.term NOT LIKE '%(product name)' AND a.term NOT LIKE '%(packaged clinical drug)' AND a.term NOT LIKE '%(real clinical drug)' AND a.term NOT LIKE '%(real medicinal product)' AND a.term NOT LIKE '%(real packaged clinical drug)' AND a.term NOT LIKE '%(supplier)'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_allterms AS SELECT a.id, a.conceptid, a.term FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS a JOIN tmp_consedited AS b ON a.conceptid = b.conceptid AND a.active = 1 WHERE a.typeid <> '900000000000003001'
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_termsmatch AS SELECT a.* FROM tmp_fsn AS a JOIN tmp_allterms AS b ON a.conceptid = b.conceptid AND a.termwithouttag = b.term

INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.conceptid, a.conceptid || ' |' || a.term || '|', a.conceptid, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_s' FROM tmp_fsn AS a LEFT JOIN tmp_termsmatch AS b ON a.conceptid = b.conceptid AND a.termwithouttag = b.termwithouttag WHERE b.conceptid IS NULL AND b.termwithouttag IS NULL
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_consedited
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_allterms
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_fsn
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_termsmatch

d76f1430-7e9a-11e1-b0c4-0800200c9a66.text: Lang refset members are active for inactive descriptions in the language refset snapshot file.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.conceptid, 'MEMBER: id=' || b.id || ': Language refset member is active for an inactive description.', b.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS a INNER JOIN rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s AS b ON a.id = b.referencedcomponentid WHERE b.active = '1' AND a.active = '0'

d9f8a8d6-2c02-11e7-b0e7-3c15c2c6e32e.text: The FSN term should be unique in active content when case sensitivity is ignored.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.conceptid, 'FSN=' || a.term || ' concept=' || a.conceptid || ': FSN term is not unique in description snapshot when case is ignored. This term already exists against active concept ' || result.conceptid || ' |' || result.term || '| in ' || result.moduleid || ' |' || d.term || '|', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.description_d' FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_d AS a, (SELECT ANY_VALUE(b.id) AS id, ANY_VALUE(b.moduleid) AS moduleid, b.term, ANY_VALUE(b.conceptid) AS conceptid, COUNT(b.id) AS total FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS b JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS c ON b.conceptid = c.id WHERE b.active = 1 AND c.active = 1 AND b.typeid = '900000000000003001' GROUP BY term HAVING total > 1) AS result, rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS d WHERE a.term = result.term AND a.id <> result.id AND a.active = 1 AND a.typeid = '900000000000003001' AND a.effectivetime = (SELECT MAX(z.effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_d AS z WHERE z.id = a.id) AND result.moduleid = d.conceptid AND d.active = 1 AND d.typeid = '900000000000003001' AND d.languagecode = 'en'

3be8c763-a5bc-404b-af9f-a2cb681f6f3d.text: IDs must be unique in the Description Snapshot file.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', ANY_VALUE(a.conceptid) AS conceptid, 'DESC: id=' || a.id || ':Non unique id in description release file.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.description_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS a GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(a.id) > 1

c82246b1-a137-40c5-8653-554c9ce82c6b.text: Active preferred terms for active concepts are unique in the same hierarchy.
statements: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_active_fsn_hierarchy

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS temp_active_fsn_hierarchy AS SELECT DISTINCT a.conceptid, a.languagecode, '(' || SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.term, '(', -1) AS semantictag FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS a JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS b ON a.conceptid = b.id WHERE a.active = 1 AND b.active = 1 AND a.typeid = '900000000000003001'
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_description_syn

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_description_syn AS SELECT a.id, a.languagecode, a.conceptid, a.term, b.semantictag AS semantictag FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS a JOIN temp_active_fsn_hierarchy AS b ON a.conceptid = b.conceptid AND a.languagecode = b.languagecode WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.typeid = '900000000000013009' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s AS c WHERE c.referencedcomponentid = a.id AND c.acceptabilityid = '900000000000548007' AND c.active = 1)

INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.conceptid, 'Preferred term=' || a.term || ' is duplicated in hierarchy ' || a.semantictag, a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.description_s' FROM tmp_description_syn AS a, (SELECT a.term, a.semantictag FROM tmp_description_syn AS a GROUP BY a.term, a.semantictag HAVING COUNT(a.id) > 1) AS duplicate WHERE a.term = duplicate.term AND a.semantictag = duplicate.semantictag

2e0eb135-fd7d-4f24-83c1-0cba797ee766.text: For a given concept, all description terms are unique.

7e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e42d640.text: Active ICD 10 extended maps must have valid mapAdvice values for corresponding mapCategory.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'ExtendedMap: id=' || a.id || ' : misaligned mapCategory and mapAdvice for ambiguous WHO concepts', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND ((a.mapCategoryId = 447635003 AND a.mapAdvice NOT LIKE '%MAPPING GUIDANCE FROM WHO IS AMBIGUOUS%') OR (a.mapCategoryId <> 447635003 AND a.mapAdvice LIKE '%MAPPING GUIDANCE FROM WHO IS AMBIGUOUS%')) AND a.refSetId = 447562003

INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'ExtendedMap: id=' || a.id || ': misaligned mapCategory and mapAdvice for incompletely modeled concepts', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND ((a.mapCategoryId = 447641005 AND a.mapAdvice NOT LIKE '%SOURCE SNOMED CONCEPT IS INCOMPLETELY MODELED%') OR (a.mapCategoryId <> 447641005 AND a.mapAdvice LIKE '%SOURCE SNOMED CONCEPT IS INCOMPLETELY MODELED%')) AND a.refSetId = 447562003

8e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e42f730.text: The mapRule for active rule based extended maps should end with a default rule and not blank.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'ExtendedMap: id=' || a.id || ' does not end with default rule', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS a, (SELECT referencedComponentId, mapGroup, MAX(mapPriority) AS maxPriority FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s GROUP BY referencedComponentId, mapGroup) AS b WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.mapRule NOT LIKE '%TRUE' AND a.refSetId IN ('447562003') AND a.referencedComponentId = b.referencedComponentId AND a.mapGroup = b.mapGroup AND a.mapPriority = b.maxPriority

INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'ExtendedMap: id=' || a.id || ' is a rule based map but with a blank rule', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.mapRule = '' AND a.refSetId IN (SELECT DISTINCT (b.refSetId) FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS b WHERE b.active = 1 AND mapRule <> '')

8e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e42f680.text: Active higher extended mapGroup have at least one non blank mapTarget.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'ExtendedMap: id=' || a.id || ' : Higher-level map group with only blank map targets', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.mapGroup > 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS b WHERE a.refSetId = b.refSetId AND a.referencedComponentId = b.referencedComponentId AND a.mapGroup = b.mapGroup AND b.mapTarget <> '')

8e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e42f750.text: Active extended map with gender mapAdvice must have corresponding gender rule.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'ExtendedMap: id=' || a.id || ' : Gender advice but without gender rule', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND mapAdvice LIKE '%MAP IS CONTEXT DEPENDENT FOR GENDER%' AND a.mapRule NOT LIKE '%IFA 248153007 | Male (finding) |%' AND a.mapRule NOT LIKE '%IFA 248152002 | Female (finding) |%'

8e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e42f700.text: Gender rules must be in alphabetical order in extended map refset.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'ExtendedMap: id=' || a.id || ': Gender mapRules out of order', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS a, rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS b WHERE a.active = 1 AND b.active = 1 AND a.refSetId = b.refSetId AND a.referencedComponentId = b.referencedComponentId AND a.mapGroup = b.mapGroup AND a.mapRule = 'IFA 248153007 | Male (finding) |' AND b.mapRule = 'IFA 248152002 | Female (finding) |' AND a.mapPriority < b.mapPriority

6e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e42e650.text: Active rule based extended map must have sequentially ordered mapGroup values without gaps.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'ExtendedMap: id=' || a.id || ' : mapgroup is blank for rule based map', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND (a.mapGroup IS NULL OR a.mapGroup = '') AND a.refSetId IN (SELECT DISTINCT (b.refSetId) FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS b WHERE b.active = 1 AND mapRule <> '')

INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'ExtendedMap: id=' || a.id || ' : Non-sequential map group:' || a.mapGroup, a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.mapGroup > 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS b WHERE a.refSetId = b.refSetId AND a.referencedComponentId = b.referencedComponentId AND b.mapGroup = a.mapGroup - 1)

8e70ea3e-c4dd-4ae3-8b75-f0567e42f710.text: Active extended IFA rule maps reference active concepts and terms.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'ExtendedMap: id=' || a.id || ' : IFA rule references an inactive concept', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.extendedmaprefset_s AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.mapRule LIKE 'IFA%' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS b WHERE b.active = 1 AND b.id = SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.mapRule, ' ', 2), 5))

statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT DISTINCT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedComponentId, 'MEMBER: id=' || a.id || ' in historical association refset member has a duplicated association with MEMBER id= ' || b.id, a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT ANY_VALUE(id) AS id, referencedComponentId, targetcomponentId, refsetid, ANY_VALUE(active) AS active, ANY_VALUE(effectivetime) AS effectivetime FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s GROUP BY referencedComponentId, targetcomponentId, refsetid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS b ON a.referencedComponentId = b.referencedComponentId AND a.targetcomponentId = b.targetcomponentId AND a.refsetid = b.refsetid AND a.id <> b.id AND ((a.effectivetime = b.effectivetime AND a.effectivetime = (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s)) OR (a.active = '1' AND b.active = '1' AND ((a.effectivetime < (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s) AND b.effectivetime < (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s)) OR (a.effectivetime <> b.effectivetime AND (a.effectivetime = (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s) OR b.effectivetime < (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s))))))

9ece50b0-cafc-4e13-a66a-a59d315e9f2c.text: Check that the expression constraints, refinements and expression templates in multiple columns in MRCM Attribute Range Refset include only valid SNOMED CT concept identifiers.
statements:
insert into qa_result
    (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name)
select 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', result.conceptId,
       concat('MRCM Attribute Range Refset', ':id=', result.id, ':ConceptId=',
              result.conceptId, ' referenced in the column ', 'rangeConstraint',
              ' is not an active concept.'),
       result.id, 'mrcmattributerangerefset_s'
from (
    select any_value(a.conceptId) as conceptId, a.id
    from (
        select t.id as id, cast(tok as bigint) as conceptId
        from rvfph_prospective_.mrcmattributerangerefset_s t,
             unnest(string_split(trim(t.rangeConstraint), ' ')) as u(tok)
        where t.active = '1'
          and regexp_matches(tok, '^[0-9]{6,20}$')
    ) a
    left join rvfph_prospective_.concept_s b on a.conceptId = b.id
    where b.id is null or b.active = '0'
    group by a.id
) as result

fc0f240c-4a07-4995-acf6-52a7f41f2ce6.text: Any refset with a refsetDescriptor record, that is a subset of another refset with a refsetDescriptor record, must have a refsetDescriptor that is either the same, or a specialisation of the parent's refset.
statements: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS rvfph_temp_.act_parent_concepts

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rvfph_temp_.act_parent_concepts AS SELECT DISTINCT a.referencedcomponentid AS concept_id, b.destinationId AS parent_id FROM rvfph_prospective_.refsetdescriptor_s AS a LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.relationship_s AS b ON a.referencedcomponentid = b.sourceid WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.refsetid = '900000000000456007' AND b.active = 1 AND b.typeid = 116680003
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS rvfph_temp_.attributedescription_and_attributetype_concept_ids

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rvfph_temp_.attributedescription_and_attributetype_concept_ids AS SELECT attributedescription AS concept_id FROM rvfph_prospective_.refsetdescriptor_s WHERE active = '1' AND refsetid = '900000000000456007' UNION SELECT attributetype AS concept_id FROM rvfph_prospective_.refsetdescriptor_s WHERE active = '1' AND refsetid = '900000000000456007'

create or replace table ancestors as
with recursive chain(concept_id, ancestor_id) as (
    select c.concept_id, r.destinationid
    from rvfph_temp_.attributedescription_and_attributetype_concept_ids c
    join rvfph_prospective_.relationship_s r
      on r.sourceid = c.concept_id and r.active = '1' and r.typeid = '116680003'
    union
    select ch.concept_id, r.destinationid
    from chain ch
    join rvfph_prospective_.relationship_s r
      on r.sourceid = ch.ancestor_id and r.active = '1' and r.typeid = '116680003'
),
joined as (
    select concept_id, ',' || string_agg(ancestor_id::varchar, ',') as parents
    from chain group by concept_id
)
select c.concept_id, coalesce(j.parents, '') as parents
from rvfph_temp_.attributedescription_and_attributetype_concept_ids c
left join joined j on j.concept_id = c.concept_id
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS rvfph_temp_.valid_ids

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rvfph_temp_.valid_ids AS SELECT a.id FROM rvfph_prospective_.refsetdescriptor_s AS a LEFT JOIN rvfph_temp_.act_parent_concepts AS b ON a.referencedcomponentid = b.concept_id LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.refsetdescriptor_s AS c ON c.referencedcomponentid = b.parent_id LEFT JOIN ancestors AS d ON a.attributedescription = d.concept_id LEFT JOIN ancestors AS e ON a.attributetype = e.concept_id WHERE b.parent_id IS NULL OR c.referencedcomponentid IS NULL OR (a.active = 1 AND a.refsetid = '900000000000456007' AND c.active = 1 AND c.refsetid = '900000000000456007' AND (a.attributedescription = c.attributedescription OR (NOT d.concept_id IS NULL AND d.parents LIKE '%' || c.attributedescription || '%')) AND (a.attributetype = c.attributetype OR (NOT e.concept_id IS NULL AND e.parents LIKE '%' || c.attributetype || '%')) AND a.attributeorder = c.attributeorder)

INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', d.referencedcomponentid, 'The refsetDescriptor id=' || d.referencedcomponentid || ' has the Attribute Description and Attribute Type which are not descendant or self of those in the parent refsetDescriptor id=' || d.parent_id || ' in the same position', d.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.refsetdescriptor_s' FROM (SELECT a.id, a.referencedcomponentid, c.parent_id FROM rvfph_prospective_.refsetdescriptor_s AS a LEFT JOIN rvfph_temp_.valid_ids AS b ON a.id = b.id LEFT JOIN rvfph_temp_.act_parent_concepts AS c ON a.referencedcomponentid = c.concept_id WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.refsetid = '900000000000456007' AND b.id IS NULL) AS d LEFT JOIN rvfph_dependency_.refsetdescriptor_s AS e ON d.id = e.id WHERE e.id IS NULL
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ancestors
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS rvfph_temp_.attributedescription_and_attributetype_concept_ids
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS rvfph_temp_.valid_ids
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS rvfph_temp_.act_parent_concepts

2ddc9a28-150d-47a4-9b0e-7dbff2efdd72.text: There is a 1:1 relationship between the id and the key values in the ASSOCIATION REFSET snapshot file.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'ReferencedComponentId:' || a.referencedcomponentid || ' targetComponentId:' || a.targetcomponentid || ' and refsetId:' || a.refsetid || ' are duplicated in the association refset snapshot file.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT ANY_VALUE(id) AS id, referencedComponentId, targetcomponentId, refsetid, ANY_VALUE(active) AS active, ANY_VALUE(effectivetime) AS effectivetime FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s GROUP BY referencedComponentId, targetcomponentId, refsetid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS b ON a.referencedComponentId = b.referencedComponentId AND a.targetcomponentId = b.targetcomponentId AND a.refsetid = b.refsetid AND a.id <> b.id AND ((a.effectivetime = b.effectivetime AND a.effectivetime = (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s)) OR (a.active = '1' AND b.active = '1' AND ((a.effectivetime < (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s) AND b.effectivetime < (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s)) OR (a.effectivetime <> b.effectivetime AND (a.effectivetime = (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s) OR b.effectivetime < (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_s))))))

de0c4d6c-6297-41be-9979-fb1c93717baa.text: There is at most one active definition per concept per dialect.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.conceptid, 'Concept id=' || a.conceptid || ' has more than one active definitions in dialect:' || b.refsetid, ANY_VALUE(a.id) AS id, 'rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s AS a, rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s AS b WHERE a.active = 1 AND b.active = 1 AND b.referencedcomponentid = a.id GROUP BY a.conceptid, b.refsetid HAVING COUNT(b.referencedcomponentid) > 1

718cc822-73b5-42c2-9c01-f8df09a9bf8d.text: There is a 1:1 relationship between the id and the immutable values in the DEFINITION snapshot.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.conceptid, 'Definition: id=' || a.id || ' references a term which is duplicated.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT ANY_VALUE(id) AS id, typeid, conceptid, languagecode, term, ANY_VALUE(active) AS active, ANY_VALUE(effectivetime) AS effectivetime FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s GROUP BY typeid, conceptid, languagecode, term HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS b ON a.typeid = b.typeid AND a.conceptid = b.conceptid AND a.languagecode = b.languagecode AND a.term = b.term AND a.id <> b.id AND (((a.active <> b.active OR (a.active = '1' AND b.active = '1')) AND a.effectivetime = b.effectivetime AND a.effectivetime = (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s)) OR (a.active = '1' AND b.active = '1' AND ((a.effectivetime < (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s) AND b.effectivetime < (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s)) OR (a.effectivetime <> b.effectivetime AND (a.effectivetime = (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s) OR b.effectivetime < (SELECT MAX(effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s))))))

3b2c1824-8445-410e-8ae2-d943be01c33f.text: There are no duplicate Definition terms in the DEFINITION snapshot file.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', ANY_VALUE(a.conceptid) AS conceptid, 'Definition id =' || ANY_VALUE(a.id) || ': Term=[' || a.term || '] is duplicate in the DEFINITION snapshot file.', ANY_VALUE(a.id) AS id, 'rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_s AS a, rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS b WHERE a.active = 1 AND b.active = 1 AND a.conceptid = b.id GROUP BY a.term HAVING COUNT(a.term) > 1

8ea2e5d9-5c35-4436-b67d-c5268b5da06c.text: Active Fully Specified Name associated with active concepts is unique in DESCRIPTION snapshot.
statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', e.conceptid, 'DESC: Active FSN =' || e.term || ': is not unique in DESCRIPTION snapshot.This term already exists against active concept(s) ' || (SELECT LISTAGG(c.conceptid || ' |' || c.term || '| in ' || c.moduleid || ' |' || f.term || '|', '; ' ORDER BY c.conceptid NULLS FIRST) FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS c INNER JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS d ON c.conceptid = d.id AND d.active = 1 LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS f ON c.moduleid = f.conceptid AND f.active = 1 AND f.typeid = '900000000000003001' AND f.languagecode = 'en' WHERE c.term = e.term AND c.id <> e.id AND c.active = 1 AND c.typeid = '900000000000003001'), e.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.description_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS e INNER JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS ec ON e.conceptid = ec.id AND ec.active = 1 INNER JOIN (SELECT a.term FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS a INNER JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS b ON a.conceptid = b.id AND b.active = 1 WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.typeid = '900000000000003001' GROUP BY a.term HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS dup ON e.term = dup.term WHERE e.active = 1 AND e.typeid = '900000000000003001'

statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', c.id, 'Concept: id=' || c.id || ' has an FSN that is defined more than one time within a given refset.', c.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.concept_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_d AS a INNER JOIN rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s AS b ON a.id = b.referencedcomponentid INNER JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS c ON a.conceptid = c.id WHERE c.active = '1' AND b.active = '1' AND a.active = '1' AND a.typeid = '900000000000003001' AND a.effectivetime = (SELECT MAX(z.effectivetime) FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_d AS z WHERE z.id = a.id) GROUP BY c.id, b.referencedcomponentid, b.refsetid HAVING COUNT(b.referencedcomponentid) > (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (refsetid)) FROM rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_s)

statements: INSERT INTO qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name) SELECT 424242424242424242, 'rvfph_assertionuuid_', a.referencedcomponentid, 'Missing dependency from: ' || a.moduleid || ' - ' || a.sourceeffectivetime || ' to: ' || b.referencedcomponentid || ' - ' || b.targeteffectivetime || ' in module dependency refset.', a.id, 'rvfph_prospective_.moduledependencyrefset_s' FROM rvfph_prospective_.moduledependencyrefset_s AS a, rvfph_prospective_.moduledependencyrefset_s AS b WHERE a.active = '1' AND b.active = '1' AND a.referencedcomponentid = b.moduleid AND a.targeteffectivetime = b.sourceeffectivetime AND NOT (a.moduleid = b.referencedcomponentid AND a.sourceeffectivetime = b.targeteffectivetime) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rvfph_prospective_.moduledependencyrefset_s AS c WHERE c.active = '1' AND a.moduleid = c.moduleid AND a.sourceeffectivetime = c.sourceeffectivetime AND b.referencedcomponentid = c.referencedcomponentid AND b.targeteffectivetime = c.targeteffectivetime)

insert into qa_result (run_id, assertion_id, concept_id, details, component_id, table_name)
	select 
	424242424242424242,
	'rvfph_assertionuuid_',
	a.referencedcomponentid,
	concat('ExpressionAssociationRefset: id=',a.id, ' is in delta file but not in snapshot file.'),
	a.id,
	'rvfph_prospective_.expressionassociationrefset_d'
	from rvfph_prospective_.expressionassociationrefset_d a
	left join rvfph_prospective_.expressionassociationrefset_s b
		on a.id = b.id
		and a.effectivetime = b.effectivetime
		and a.active = b.active
		and a.moduleid = b.moduleid
		and a.refsetid = b.refsetid
		and a.referencedcomponentid = b.referencedcomponentid
		and a.mapTarget = b.mapTarget
		and a.expression = b.expression
		and a.definitionStatusId = b.definitionStatusId
		and a.correlationId = b.correlationId
		and a.contentOriginId = b.contentOriginId
	where 
	(b.id is null
	or b.effectivetime is null
	or b.active is null
	or b.moduleid is null
	or b.refsetid is null
	or b.referencedcomponentid is null
	or b.mapTarget is null
	or b.expression is null
	or b.definitionStatusId is null
	or b.correlationId is null
	or b.contentOriginId is null)
	and a.effectivetime = (select max(z.effectivetime) from rvfph_prospective_.expressionassociationrefset_d z where z.id = a.id)
commit

statements: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS res_concepts_edited
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS res_concepts_edited (conceptid TEXT(36))
TRUNCATE TABLE res_concepts_edited

INSERT INTO res_concepts_edited SELECT DISTINCT id FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_s WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM rvfph_prospective_.concept_d UNION SELECT conceptid FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_d UNION SELECT conceptid FROM rvfph_prospective_.textdefinition_d UNION SELECT sourceid FROM rvfph_prospective_.stated_relationship_d UNION SELECT referencedcomponentid FROM rvfph_prospective_.owlexpressionrefset_d UNION SELECT b.conceptid FROM rvfph_prospective_.langrefset_d AS a LEFT JOIN rvfph_prospective_.description_s AS b ON a.referencedcomponentid = b.id UNION SELECT referencedcomponentid FROM rvfph_prospective_.attributevaluerefset_d WHERE refsetid = '900000000000489007' UNION SELECT a.conceptid FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_d AS a JOIN rvfph_prospective_.attributevaluerefset_d AS b ON a.id = b.referencedcomponentid WHERE b.refsetid = '900000000000490003' UNION SELECT referencedcomponentid FROM rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_d WHERE refsetid IN ('900000000000523009', '900000000000526001', '900000000000527005', '900000000000530003', '1186924009', '1186921001') UNION SELECT a.conceptid FROM rvfph_prospective_.description_d AS a JOIN rvfph_prospective_.associationrefset_d AS b ON a.id = b.referencedcomponentid WHERE b.refsetid = '900000000000531004' UNION SELECT referencedcomponentid FROM rvfph_prospective_.simplerefset_d UNION SELECT referencedcomponentid FROM rvfph_prospective_.simplemaprefset_d)
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS res_edited_active_concepts
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS res_edited_active_concepts AS SELECT b.* FROM res_concepts_edited AS a JOIN rvfph_prospective_.concept_s AS b ON a.conceptid = b.id AND b.active = 1
